news.title: Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech says hello
news.summary: Google DeepMind has released Gemini 3.8, an updated text‑to‑speech model that can generate realistic, natural‑sounding audio from text prompts. This model expands on Gemini’s multimodal capabilities, adding voice output to its suite of text and image processing features.

news.summary: Microsoft Research reports that offloading AI inference from robotic hardware to external systems can improve task success rates and efficiency for physical AI workloads.

news.summary_raw:
